features.title: Announcements (create + share audience, manage/remove)
Layout variants — 3 switchable UX shells (Classic sidebar / Raga top-nav / Studio icon-rail) for design-direction review
features.evidence: frontend/src/components/layout/portal-chrome.tsx dispatches to shells/{classic,raga,studio}-shell.tsx by the active variant on <html data-theme>; each shell is a distinct information architecture (persistent left sidebar / horizontal top-nav with sargam ribbon + centred editorial column / floating translucent icon-rail + Cmd-K command palette), not a recolour. Palette+type per variant in globals.css :root[data-theme] blocks (Classic MKSM-red serif / Raga night-indigo+marigold Fraunces / Studio Apple-blue Inter). Switcher: frontend/src/components/layout/layout-switcher.tsx; variant model + no-FOUC pre-paint script + isThemeId guard: frontend/src/config/theme.ts (tested, frontend/src/config/theme.test.ts). Built with apple-design (Studio) + frontend-design/redesign-skill (top-nav over sidebar; night-raga palette grounded in the subject, not the terracotta-cream default). Verified in-browser: all 3 shells render across student/admin + login, switch persists via localStorage, Cmd-K filters+navigates, mobile drawers, clean console, 34 tests + build green. Accepted tradeoff: dispatcher renders Classic on SSR/first paint then swaps to the stored shell after mount (colors are correct instantly via the pre-paint script; nav structure reflows once for non-classic viewers) — an SSR-inlined variant (e.g. cookie) would remove the reflow in M2.

gates.solid: Schema derived directly from frontend/src/data/types.ts + PRD §6/§8 — no invented entities. Enum tables vs pg enums chosen by whether admins edit the set.
gates.secure_by_default: RLS enabled + FORCE on all 34 public tables (0 without RLS, verified); subscriptions/payments have no client-write policy (service_role sync only); audit_log/notification_log have no client policy at all.

gates.verification: migrate applied 17/17; psql checks — 34 tables, 7 views, 44 enums, all helper fns + auth trigger present, 0 RLS-disabled public tables; seed loaded; all 7 views return rows.

Login/forgot-password give no user enumeration; fail() never leaks stacks. Recorded gaps: no app-level rate limiting (edge/middleware later); GET /files/:id allows any authenticated user (mitigated: private buckets + UUID paths + 10-min signed URLs); seed.ts SQL fallback writes bcrypt hashes directly (dev only).
